REPAIR.purpose: Fix a newly diagnosed weakness with a simpler, targeted exercise.

NEAR_TRANSFER.purpose: Apply the same skill/pattern in a closely related problem.

FAR_TRANSFER.purpose: Apply the same abstract skill in a different algorithmic domain.

CONTRAST.purpose: Discriminate between superficially similar problems requiring different reasoning.

RETENTION.purpose: Redo after spacing to test durable recall without old-solution leakage.

STRETCH.purpose: Raise difficulty one step after stable mastery evidence.

CONTEST.purpose: Train time allocation, partial scoring, and decision-making under contest constraints.
